board.summary: Fresh discovery was completed from the configured Bad Left Hook homepage and current internal fight-week links before yesterday's cards were reviewed. NEW TODAY: 3 selections — Itauma-Hrgovic Under 6.5 Rounds, Hrgovic by KO/TKO/DQ, and Caroline Dubois by Decision. CARRIED FORWARD: 5 selections — Cameron ML, Cameron by Decision, Hrgovic ML, Berinchyk ML, and Plantic ML. No PLAY is live. Material new information changed the heavyweight cluster: Bad Left Hook published same-day interviews in which Hrgovic explicitly framed Itauma as most dangerous early and himself as more dangerous late, while Itauma questioned Hrgovic's fragility; the market simultaneously shortened Hrgovic from yesterday's best +700 area to a same-day best around +600. That price move makes the prior Hrgovic ML even less attractive, but it creates two fresh method/round ideas worth monitoring at better numbers. Cameron's positive fight-week thesis remains intact, while her current ML has shortened to about +215 and her decision price remains too short near +370. Berinchyk and Plantic remain price-dependent underdog watches. The current-day-only display remains in force.
